newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania T-bill issue heavily undersubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romania T-bill issue heavily undersubscribed.

text.p: An issue of 250 billion lei of Romanian three-month treasury bills was heavily under- subscribed on Friday with only one bank bidding, latest central bank data showed.
State-run Banc Post SA bought only 10 billion lei of the new 91-day T-bills offering an annual yield of 51.48 percent and maturing on March 14, 1997.
Traders said the money market was dried up of leu funds with most banks chasing leu funds for year-end outflows and in a bid to meet their minimum reserve targets.
Results of subscriptions will be available on BNR01. ($=3,732 lei) -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
